messages.subject: Occasions with no captures
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am getting the following error "some occassion names in EDF not in TDF" when running  data2oscr on multisession data. I do not get this error when I have captures on every occasion. However, I get the error when I include a session for which I am missing data (no captures) for some occasions. For example, the occasion column would look like this: 11111222233336666... This leads me to believe that the error occurs because I am missing lines for some occasions.

How can I integrate occasions with no captures in the data so as to not receive the error?

Thank you

Joel

messages.subject: RE: [oscr] Occasions with no captures
messages.body_plain:
Hi Joel,

I don’t this having no detections in one of the occasions is the issue here. For example, I create a similar situation here and things run fine:

data("rbs_ecography")               #load salamander data

r1 <- subset(rbs.edf,Session == 1)  #subset to just session 1

table(r1$Occasion)                  #see there are dets in all seven occs

1  2  3  4  5  6  7

 9 12 25 24 26 32 19

r1 <- subset(r1,Occasion %in% c(1:3,5:7)) #now remove occ 4

table(r1$Occasion)                        #no detection is occ 4

1  2  3  5  6  7

 9 12 25 26 32 19

#now construct the scrFrame (which works):

sf <- data2oscr(edf = r1, tdf = list(rbs.tdf1),

                sess.col = 1, id.col = 2, occ.col = 3, trap.col = 4,

                K = 7, ntraps=nrow(rbs.tdf1))$scrFrame

#and now examining the caphist object we see no detections in occasion 4:

apply(sf$caphist[[1]],c(3),sum)

[1]  9 12 25  0 26 32 19

All this is to say that there is a different issue. Are you sure you have provided the right value of K?

Chris
